tools.name: begin_free_lifetime_vault
tools.description: Open Evaheld's guided signup for a free lifetime Legacy Vault. The user creates their own account and may answer or skip onboarding questions; this tool never creates an account or accepts terms for them.

tools.name: choose_evaheld_plan
tools.description: Open Evaheld's published Vault plans for human comparison. The live page currently includes a free plan, a Premium Lifetime Vault and the Founding Family pair offer; this tool never starts checkout or makes a purchase.

focus.description: Optional plan to focus while opening Evaheld's Plans page.

tools.name: explore_partner_solutions
tools.description: Open Evaheld's public partnership information for client, member or staff benefits, aged care, health care, financial services, legal and estate planning, or end-of-life care.

sector.description: Partnership sector or benefit type to explore.

tools.name: open_family_readiness_checklist
tools.description: Open Evaheld's public Family Readiness Checklist for practical planning. This read-only tool does not create, store or change a checklist in a private Vault.

tools.name: open_founding_family_offer
tools.description: Open Evaheld's published Founding Family offer for two independently controlled Premium Lifetime Vaults, either the general or parents version. The live offer page controls price and availability; this tool never starts checkout.

audience.description: Open the general family or parents version of the offer.

tools.name: search_evaheld_blog
tools.description: Prepare a search of the public Evaheld Blog for family legacy, stories, planning, health, care, wills, estate administration, documents, partners or related guidance.

query.description: Article title, tag, category or planning topic to search.

tools.name: search_evaheld_faqs
tools.description: Search Evaheld's public FAQ catalogue for Legacy Vault, plans, privacy, security, stories, care wishes, estate planning, family access, life stages or partner questions.

query.description: Question, phrase or topic to search in Evaheld's public FAQs.

tools.name: start_evaheld_enquiry
tools.description: Open Evaheld's contact page and prepare a published inquiry category plus an optional message. The user supplies and reviews personal details and controls Send Message; this tool never submits the form.

message.description: Optional draft message for the user to review before sending.

tools.name: subscribe_to_evaheld_updates
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to Evaheld guides, resources and product updates.

tools.name: view_evaheld_security
tools.description: Open Evaheld's public security information. This tool does not inspect an account, session, stored document or any private Vault content.

tools.name: view_evaheld_story
tools.description: Open Evaheld's public company story, mission and background. This read-only tool does not access account or Vault information.

tools.name: view_vault_features
tools.description: Open Evaheld's public feature information for the complete Digital Legacy Vault, Story & Legacy, Health & Care, or Essentials. It exposes no private Vault data.

feature.description: Public Evaheld feature area to view.
